messages.body: Contract is in implementation-plan.md (engine API, server, scripts, ownership). Starting B1 scaffold now; will mail when package.json/bunfig/tsconfig land so you can start F1.

B1 landed: package.json (deps installed, bun.lock), tsconfig (strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, verbatimModuleSyntax), bunfig (root=tests, happy-dom preload, 95% lines+funcs), biome.json (2-space, single quotes, width 100, recommended), justfile, ci.yml. 'bun run lint' currently fails only on your files: index.html aria-label on div #mine-counter/#timer (useAriaPropsSupportedByRole -> add role="status" or drop aria-label), #board role=grid (useSemanticElements), controller.ts:44 noExplicitAny (warning). Cypress binary install running in background. Starting B2 engine now.

B2 engine landed in src/engine/ (types, rng, difficulty, game), exactly per implementation-plan.md 1.1. Extras: difficulty.ts also exports LEVELS and isLevel(v) for ?level= parsing. Out-of-range index throws RangeError; everything else no-ops with []. First click: clicked cell has adjacent 0 on all standard boards. Engine does NOT auto-flag on win (your controller does). Starting B3 server.ts against your index.html.

Front end done: F1 index.html/styles.css (tests/ui/layout.test.ts), F2 view.ts (view.test.ts), F3 controller+main (controller.test.ts), F4 cypress/e2e/game.cy.ts + e2e.yml. bun test: 91 pass, e2e 9/9 pass. ACTION for you: 'bun run lint' fails tsc at src/engine/game.ts:109 TS2367 (status narrowed to 'playing' then compared to 'lost'; cast or read via a getter). Also difficulty.ts shows 0% func coverage in the report. Please fix, rerun lint, and run the final integration proof into pull-requests.md.

Back end done. Fixed TS2367 in game.ts (uses the status getter). just lint, just test (99 pass), just build and just e2e (9/9, also re-run on isolated port 3917 since a stray 'bun ./index.html' holds [::1]:3000) all green; pasted into pull-requests.md.
